# Mangayomi Sources

Install the manga source list in Mangayomi:

- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hk-0nl/host/main/hosting/dist/mangayomi/manga_index.json`

The legacy-compatible index URL is:

- `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hk-0nl/host/main/hosting/dist/manga_index.json`

Current source:

- Gelbooru v0.0.3: mixed image/GIF/WebM/MP4 support, optional API credentials,
  local tag blacklist, account-free `Display all site content`, and anonymous
  HTML fallback when DAPI access requires authentication.
